a.lede: Some iPhone 18 Pro Max phones on AT&T are stuck in SOS mode. Two updates can prevent it, but affected phones need replacing.
a.title: iPhone 18 Pro Max can’t call or text on AT&T? Apple will replace it for free

b.lede: Modern smartphone operating systems are designed to automatically update your apps without you noticing. Here's why you should give it a hand once in a while.
b.title: Here's why it's important to keep your phone apps updated
